# London Furnace Repair

> London Furnace Repair is a local HVAC company serving London, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 709-3822  |  Email: contact@londonfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://londonfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: London, St. Thomas, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan
